purpose: Collect the most recently disclosed official Tencent (00700 / 0700.HK) issued-share count from HKEX monthly return / next-day disclosure in the October-end to mid-November 2026 window, and a same-relationship official close for cross-check. The official quotations file https://www.hkex.com.hk/eng/stat/smstat/dayquot/d261031e.htm returned HTTP 404. The last SEHK session on or before the month-end share date was Friday 30 October 2026.

weekend_gap_between_price_and_share_date.note: The official share count is as at close of 31 October 2026, not as at the 30 October 2026 market close. This collection did not locate a next-day disclosure or other official issued-share figure dated 30 October 2026. Employee option exercises of 39,234 shares occurred sometime during October; the last Next Day Disclosure Return located on the HKEX title search was 15 October 2026. It is not independently proven that the issued count was unchanged between the 30 October close and the 31 October close, although a Saturday issuance or cancellation is not documented in the monthly return's movement details.

staleness_versus_access_date_2026_11_17.comparison_with_2026_06_30_if_paired_to_: The 30 June 2026 official issued count would be 140 calendar days stale versus 17 November 2026. The October month-end pair is closer, but it is still not a 17 November 2026 same-day official share and close combination.

recommended_traceable_pair_for_cloud_rev.not_a_current_mark_to_market: A 17 November 2026 live or 16 November 2026 latest daily close must not be multiplied by the 31 October 2026 share count. Those prices were observed, but they are recorded only as unused freshness context.

gating_implication_for_cloud_review: This package supplies a closer, traceable official share count (9,092,644,829 as at 2026-10-31) and an official SEHK close (HKD 383.60 on 2026-10-30), with Sina and Yahoo agreeing on that close. It does not, by itself, constitute acceptance of a FinRobot input gate. The share date and the price date differ by a weekend; award-scheme holdings were not found in the October monthly return; no official independent market cap was found; and the pair is still 17–18 calendar days before the 17 November 2026 access date. A financial reporting period ended 30 June 2026 may reasonably sit beside a later quote date, but any share-to-quote bridge must keep this dating explicit. Official TTM flow items are unchanged and remain as at 30 June 2026.
